name: Silent Image
summary: A purely visual illusion of an object, creature or phenomenon up to a 15-foot Cube that you can move.
text: Create a purely visual image of an object, a creature or some other visible phenomenon, no larger than a 15-foot Cube, at a spot within range. It has no sound, smell or other sensory effects. As a Magic action you can move the image to any spot within range and change its appearance as it moves so the motion looks natural (for example, making a creature appear to walk). Things pass through the image, so physical contact reveals it as an illusion. A creature that takes the Study action to examine it can tell it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; a creature that sees through it can see through the image. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
